title: Affine perfect models and geometric scalar-extension comparison
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRing a diagram with colimiting cocone c, and i∈I. Let Y be affine [def-pc-scheme], with s:Y→Spec R(i) locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume chosen scheme-derived categories and chosen derived categories on all localized opens of Y, in Hom universe w, and module-derived categories in Hom universe u+1 [def-pc-derived-category]. For perfect P,Q in D(O_Y) [def-pc-perfect-complex], there exist a ring diagram F on J={j|i≤j}, with initial object o=i, and bounded finite-projective complexes E,K over F(o). For every j in J above o there is an equivalence from Hom_D(F(j))(E⊗F(j),K⊗F(j)) to the Hom set between the stipulated geometric derived pullbacks of P,Q [def-pc-derived-pullback]. There is the corresponding equivalence at colim F to the stipulated pullbacks over c.pt. On each chain-map representative, these equivalences identify canonical scalar extension [def-pc-complex-scalar-extension-hom] with perfectStageMap and perfectLimitMap [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. No Type-valued Hom diagram, cocone, or module transition equations are asserted.

proof.text: Identify the affine scheme Y with Spec of its global sections. Form the coordinate-ring diagram on the tail above i by tensor extension and identify its colimit with the coordinate ring of the limit pullback. The identifications are induced by the universal properties of Spec, pullback and tensor product. Tensor extension is a left adjoint and preserves colimits.

Transport P and Q along Y.isoSpec using the exact scheme-isomorphism derived equivalence and its preservation of perfectness and quasi-coherent homology. The localized-site equivalences transfer the required open-site derived categories without changing their Hom universe. Apply the affine bounded-projective criterion, obtaining bounded finite-projective complexes E and K, and transport them through the canonical isomorphism B tensor over R(i) with R(i) equals B. The affine derived equivalence gives the stage and limit Hom equivalences after the affine pullback comparison computes scalar extension on these flat complexes.

Take the stage and limit Hom equivalences directly from the affine derived equivalences and conjugate by the tilde/pullback comparisons. Naturality on chain maps and the counit-pinned composition comparison identify these scalar-extension conjugations with perfectStageMap and perfectLimitMap. This is precisely the last two equations, with source the actual module-derived Hom sets; no H or cocone is involved.

theorem exists_affinePerfectChainGeometricModels
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ A : CommRingCat.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hP : Y.IsPerfect P) (hQ : Y.IsPerfect Q) :
    ∃ (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
      (E K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩)) ℤ),
      ((∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (E.X n)) ∧
        ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩) (E.X n) ∧
          Module.Projective (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩) (E.X n)) ∧
      ((∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (K.X n)) ∧
        ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩) (K.X n) ∧
          Module.Projective (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩) (K.X n)) ∧
      ∃ (stage : ∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i),
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
           DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≃
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s
            (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))).obj P ⟶
           (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s
            (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.val.property))))).obj Q))
        (limit :
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (colimit.ι F ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
           DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (colimit.ι F ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≃
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj P ⟶
           (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj Q)),
        (∀ (j k : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i)) (hjk : j ≤ k)
          (f : ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
          stage k (DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.scalarExtensionHom
              (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom (F.map (homOfLE hjk)).hom
              (F.map (homOfLE k.property)).hom
              (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (F.map_comp
                (homOfLE j.property) (homOfLE hjk))) E K f)) =
            perfectStageMap R s j.val.property hjk
              (stage j (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))) ∧
        (∀ (j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i))
          (f : ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
          limit (DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.scalarExtensionHom
              (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom (colimit.ι F j.val).hom
              (colimit.ι F ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom
              (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (colimit.w F (homOfLE j.property)).symm)
              E K f)) =
            perfectLimitMap R c s j.val.property
              (stage j (DerivedCategory.Q.map f)))
